scope: Theorem 5.4 (Chow relation) of the manuscript “Bloch’s conjecture for surfaces with p_g=0” (preprints/Blochs-Conjecture-for-Surfaces-with-pg-equals-q-equals-0-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 040 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 afb7bf56f8d97111), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 29. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For either surface setting, and any p ≥ 0 with v > p + 2, sum the classes (5.6) with the following multiplicities: (i) If pg = q = 0, sum over the effective ordered line pairs T + H = D and nonnegative point lengths satisfying (4.2), with mT , mH ≥ 0. Each fixed part has multiplier 1. (ii) In the auxiliary setting, D = 3K. Sum over the ordered pairs (3K, 0), (0, 3K) with multiplier 1, and (2K, K), (K, 2K) with multiplier −s, with the admissible point lengths. Here s > 0 is the canonical-divisor coefficient of (4.16). All sums are finite. Writing c for the same weighted sum of the coefficients chosen in Proposition 5.3, one obtains 0 = c[ΔX] + Γ in CH2 (X × X), (5.16) where Γ is a sum of external products of total codimension two.
